question: Which is the marine ecological realm that experiences the effects of tidal and longshore currents and breaking waves to a depth of 5 to 10 metres below the low-tide level, depending on the intensity of storm waves?
solution:
The correct answer is** __littoral zone__.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Littoral Zone is the area of** the shoreline where land is subject to wave action it is a Grassy, reedy, marshy region present along the perimeter of the shoreline.**
 
• There are 3 types of Littoral Zone namely **Supralittoral, Intertidal, and sublittoral zone.**
 
• The organisms found in** Littoral Zone are Mussels, Starfish, barnacles, Chitons, etc.**
 
• These zones play an important role in **preventing soil erosion **and are also referred to as **water cleaners since they prevent the spread of water pollutants.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information __**

 
• **Profoundal Zone** is a deep zone of an inland body of freestanding water such as a lake or pond.
 
• **Benthic Zone** is the lowest ecological zone in the water body and usually involves the sediments at the seafloor.
 
• **The limnetic zone** is the open and well-lit area of a freestanding body of freshwater.
